intro: This awareness course introduced Positive Behaviour Support — a values-based, person-centred way of understanding behaviour as communication and supporting people to live well.
points: This is awareness only; PBS plans and functional assessments are led by trained professionals — follow each plan consistently.
Physical intervention needs specific, accredited training and is always a last resort — never attempt a hold you are not trained for.
Work in the least restrictive way; under the Mental Capacity Act, decisions must be in the person's best interests.
Understand behaviour as communication of an unmet need or distress; ask what the person needs, not simply how to stop it.
Focus on proactive, primary prevention — a good environment, meaningful activity, real choice and predictable routines — so distress is far less likely.
Record and review every use of restriction, and make sure both the person and colleagues receive support after any incident.
